criteria.name: unmet_need
criteria.description: Frequency and severity of the pain for a broad developer audience

criteria.name: differentiation
criteria.description: Defensible separation from prior art located in the bounded landscape search

criteria.name: time_to_value
criteria.description: Minutes from install to a first result a developer would act on

criteria.name: build_feasibility
criteria.description: Correctly buildable in one sandbox with the Python standard library

criteria.name: evidence_integrity
criteria.description: The tool can state its own evidence boundary without overclaiming proof

criteria.name: distribution_leverage
criteria.description: Shareable output, runtime neutrality, README-as-product, trend alignment

criteria.name: maintenance_burden
criteria.description: Ongoing churn from fast-moving vendor APIs, formats, or adversarial rule lists
